en.title: How to Get a TIN in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: A TIN is a Taxpayer Identification Number used in Bangladesh’s tax system. Use the official NBR e-TIN service and enter identity information exactly. Having a TIN and having a tax payable are not the same thing. A person may also have a return-filing duty even when final tax is low or zero.

atAGlance.legalBasis: Income Tax Act, 2023; NBR e-TIN services and forms.
atAGlance.mainRule: The exact list of people who must have TIN or proof of return can change, so link this guide to the current “Who must file” page.

en.lawMeaning: The exact list of people who must have TIN or proof of return can change, so link this guide to the current “Who must file” page. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Open the official NBR e-TIN service.
Use correct NID/passport and contact data.
Correct errors through the official process.
evidence: NID/passport as applicable; mobile/email; address; business information if relevant.
en.simpleExample: A person gets a TIN for a bank or property transaction but has no taxable income. They should still check whether the law requires a return or proof of filing because the TIN itself does not answer that question.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: sharing passwords with agents.
Common mistakes: thinking TIN means tax is automatically due..
